string.text: What brings you here, brother? You killed the leader of those Freedom anarchists and their group has crumbled. The war is not over but its outcome is certain. Your achievements are great and they will not be forgotten.

What brings you here, brother? You killed the leader of those Freedom anarchists and their group has crumbled. The war is not over but its outcome is certain. Your achievements are great and they will not be forgotten.
The war with Freedom is coming to an end, Marked One. You played your part in fighting for the cause and now I want to finish this war. I want you to kill the Freedom leader.
What brings you here, brother?
What brought you to me, brother?
I'm listening.
You brought the Bulldog 6?
Yes, here is the Bulldog 6.
Good work, stalker. This is exactly what we need. Well, Marked One, you carried out my request, and in return you can take this suit. I think you'll like it.
Barkeep told me that you have some assignment for me at the military warehouses...

I want to ask you to do one thing, personally for me, you see? We're in the midst of territorial warefare with the Freedom faction and we need some weapons more powerful than what we have. Freedom has some excellent Bulldog 6 granade launchers. If you could penetrate their territory and steal at least one such granade launcher, I would generously reward you. Since you aren't in our faction, you can quickly gain the trust of Freedom and, if you're lucky, get a hold of the Bulldog 6.
Go on.

I'll upload the location of the Freedom base for you. You'll need to find the Chef. He's a member of Freedom. He knows where the RG-6s are kept. And he likes his booze so bring a lot of vodka with you. So, what do you say?
OK, I'll try to steal an Bulldog 6 from Freedom.

Oh, and one more thing. Colonel Skull and his boys disobeyed my order and decided to attack the Freedom base without authorization. Well, they can reap what they sow... suicidal bastards. Don't get involved in their fight. Just try to get me the Bulldog 6 - nothing else matters.
I'm not ready for such exploits just yet.
Up to you.
I am ready to swear the oath.
Good man! Repeat after me: "I, a stalker known as the Marked One, swear to defend the goals and ideals of Duty."
I, a stalker known as the Marked One, swear to defend the goals and ideals of Duty.
To protect the Earth from the dangers of the Zone, to seek out and destroy anything it spawns within and beyond its borders.
To protect the Earth from the dangers of the Zone, to seek out and destroy anything it spawns within and beyond its borders.
To fight any nonconformists, be they individual stalkers or groups.
To fight any nonconformists, be they individual stalkers or groups.
And to give my life in the name of justice and order on Earth!
And to give my life in the name of justice and order on Earth!
Congratulations! You are now a full member of Duty.
I completed the mission. I brought the Bulldog 6.
Good work, stalker. This is exactly what we need. Well, Marked One, you carried out my request, and in return you can take this suit. I think you'll like it.
What can I do for Duty?

That's a good question, Marked One and there's an equally good answer to it - kill Freedom anarchists. You'll get a reward for every PDA of theirs you bring and you might get promoted too. Take all the PDAs you get to Petrenko - he gives out the rewards.
Hello brother! What brings you to me?
How can I help?
I'm listening.
Go on, bro. Remember: Duty's mission is to cleanse.
What are you standing there for? Keep moving.
Halt! Outsiders aren't allowed in the Duty base!
Why don't you let outsiders in?
Where did you naive boys come from? There's a war going on, right? We’re fighting Freedom bandits! We have regular skirmishes with their fighters in the Wild Territory.
A war with Freedom? Why?
Because there is no place for those Freedom bandits in the Zone - they must be destroyed. If you're interested, go ask the Barkeep to explain everything. I'm busy.
I want to join Duty. What do I need to do?
Pay 1000 roubles. You'll get a pass. Take that to Voronin in the bunker and he'll arrange a test for you.
OK, here's the money.
Right, here is your pass. Go see Petrenko, the administrator. I've marked it on your map.
No, I changed my mind.
Your choice, man. See you.
Hello, friend.
What do you want?
I'm listening.
I bought a pass at the gate. What do I have to do to join Duty?
Before we get to the conclusions, pass an easy test. Win a fight against the pseudodog on the Arena, then come back to me. When that is done we'll decide whether you're fit to join Duty or not.
Understood.
I won on the Arena.
Not bad. Go see Voronin in the bunker, he decides the rest.
You got any special jobs?

I've got a serious mission. A group of veteran killers has showed up in the Wild Territory again. Some Duty people came to me and asked me to deal with these veterans. Duty has solid proof that they are responsible for the deaths of solo stalkers. The problem is that these veterans and Duty have some old agreement and Duty can't break it but these guys are really pushing it. Basically, Duty wants 'em taken out, nice and quiet. It ain't gonna be easy but the job is worth a lot of dough.
Anything else?
Duty values its reputation, which is why they need this thing done quietly. All you gotta do is kill their leader Lucky and bring me his PDA as proof.
I'll do it.
Good decision, man. There ain't nothing to regret about it.
No, I'm not up for it.
Up to you but remember that this is a good opportunity to earn Duty's gratitude.
Don't get carried away, Marked One. You are looking for more work but you haven't even dealt with the veterans yet...

Your mission is to kill Tyran, the leader of the Mercs. His crew made it into the Wild Territory and set up a base at the construction site. Be careful, some of their fighters have set up ambushes on the way to the site. Bring me Tyran's PDA and the reward is yours.
I'll do it.
Good decision, man. There ain't nothing to regret about it.
No, I'm not up for it.
As you wish.
No, nothing today.
Here is Lucky's PDA. I did what you asked.
Nice, Marked One. Great job! What can I say? You made me happy, man. I wasn't sure you'd manage, to be honest...but you're alive and they're not!
What about the reward?
You're a hero, man, a real hero. Here, that should make you happy.
I accomplished my mission. Here is Tyran's PDA.
Wow, Marked One. Great job! What can I say? You made me happy, man. I wasn't sure you'd manage, to be honest...but you're alive and they're not!
What about my reward?
Here. Your reward as promised.
Sergeant Plichko
Chief of Duty's territory security
Captain Ivantsov
Commander of all punitive raids and expeditions against any horde of mutants.
Lucky

Looter and a murderer. A price has been set for his head. Formerly on good terms with Duty, helped them win over their territory. Now dwells in the Wild Territory and mugs lonely stalkers with his gang.
Tyran
One of the "heroes" of the Merc gang. A veteran with bullets of all calibers in his body. A rare psychopath and sadist.
